Cargo at route stops

Choose a route and one of its stops, then list up to six goods to unload and up to six to load. Goods are handled from the top of each list down, and unloading comes before loading. When hold space, warehouse room or money runs short, the goods higher in a list get it first, so use Move up and Move down to set the priority. Opening this window or loading a saved game moves no goods; goods move only when you process a ship or wagon that stands at the stop.
